projects.title: Office Renovation - 3rd Floor
projects.description: Complete renovation of the 3rd floor office space including painting, flooring, electrical work, and furniture installation. The space needs to accommodate 20 workstations with modern amenities.

projects.title: New Conference Room Setup
projects.description: Setup of a new conference room with audio-visual equipment, video conferencing system, smart board, and seating for 30 people. Includes network infrastructure and acoustic treatment.

projects.title: Parking Lot Expansion Project
projects.description: Expand the existing parking lot to add 50 additional parking spaces. Includes asphalt paving, line marking, lighting installation, and drainage system.

bookings.purpose: Annual Staff Conference - Company-wide annual conference with keynote speakers, presentations, and awards ceremony.

maintenance.title: Electrical Outlet Not Working - Room 305
maintenance.description: Multiple electrical outlets in Room 305 are not functioning. Computers and equipment cannot be powered. This is affecting daily operations and needs urgent attention.

maintenance.title: Air Conditioning Not Cooling - 2nd Floor
maintenance.description: The air conditioning system on the entire 2nd floor is not cooling properly. Temperature is uncomfortably high (30°C+). Staff are complaining about the heat.

maintenance.title: Water Leak in Restroom - 1st Floor
maintenance.description: Significant water leak detected in the men's restroom on the 1st floor. Water is pooling on the floor and may cause damage. Appears to be coming from under the sink.
